project: RB Agent OS — Autonomous Developer Environment
overview: Autonomous task tracking and execution queue for Ralph Loop, GSD-Core, and Antigravity pair programming.

userStories.title: Module Verification & Health Check
userStories.description: Ensure GSD-Core, Ralph Loop, Roo Code, and CodeRabbit modules are active and integrated with Antigravity.
acceptanceCriteria: All core CLI binaries (gsd-core, ralph-loop, coderabbit-review, agent-workflow) are available in PATH
CodeRabbit automated review reports zero syntax errors and zero critical vulnerabilities
Lovable UI designs, sticky input bar layouts, and component structures remain 100% intact

userStories.title: Autonomous Error Self-Healing Loop Validation
userStories.description: Verify that build failures or API mismatches automatically trigger stack trace analysis and self-healing.
acceptanceCriteria: Self-healing handler intercepts exceptions without prompting user
Clean API integration bypasses sk_ prefix restrictions and supports direct Gemini AIzaSy... keys

userStories.title: TTS Speech Synthesis Pause, Resume & Bookmark Fix
userStories.description: Fix text-to-speech audio player in chat responses to save exact character/word position when paused/stopped via speech or mic button, resuming seamlessly without resetting.
acceptanceCriteria: SpeechEngine stores exact character/word offset on pause and prevents cancel() from wiping offset to zero
Resuming continues from the exact word/position where paused
Mic button in InputBar auto-pauses speech and saves bookmark

userStories.title: Persistent Media State & Audio/Video Resume Player
userStories.description: Implement media/audio player component with persistent timestamp state across frontend and backend service.
acceptanceCriteria: Media state saves currentTime, duration, and metadata to localStorage and /api/media-state
Paused media resumes precisely from currentTime instead of resetting to zero
Integrate media player into file preview (files.tsx) and chat response cards

userStories.title: Android Intent & Custom URI Deep-Link Automation
userStories.description: Integrate Android Intent and custom URI schemes in agent tools for direct YouTube and media app launch.
acceptanceCriteria: Recognize requests like 'open YouTube and play [song]'
Execute Android Intent via am start or termux-open-url rather than giving manual text steps
Provide direct launch fallback action card in the UI

userStories.title: Media Control Actions & Command Recognition
userStories.description: Implement robust command recognition for play, pause, resume, and seek via voice input and chat interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Instant recognition of play/pause/resume/seek commands in speech input and chat messages
Control active TTS speech and media player playback seamlessly
Verify build passes and CodeRabbit reports 0 syntax errors and 0 security issues
